newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK airline sends rescued giant turtles to Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: HK airline sends rescued giant turtles to Malaysia.

text.p: Thirteen giant turtles, some rescued from poachers, are to be flown back to their home region in Malaysia, the Hong Kong airline Dragonair said on Friday. Eight of the turtles were seized by inspectors from the Agriculture and Fisheries Department in circumstances the airline did not specify and five were reared in Hong Kong.

The airline, which serves destinations in China and the Asia-Pacific region, said it had agreed to ship the turtles back to the island of Borneo because Hong Kong's climate and environment were unsuitable for the creatures.
The turtles will make an appearance for the media on Tuesday morning before boarding a flight (KA/MH061) to Kota Kinabalu in east Malaysia.
